description.zh: 穿墙高亮掉落物与可采集物、非空战利品容器、地窖入口和活体敌人；R 拿取当前容器全部物品，拿空后关闭容器和背包；F 开关个人头灯；可调整基础负重。
description.en: Highlights items, non-empty loot containers, cellar entrances and living enemies through walls; R takes everything from the open container and closes it and the backpack when empty; F toggles a personal headlamp; adjustable base carry weight.
